questions.question: How much should I budget?
questions.answer: Website packages start at $1,400, plus your domain, hosting, paid tools, taxes and any approved additions. Compare all prices.

questions.question: How soon can a website launch?
questions.answer: Planned build work: Launch 3–5 business days, Focused 5–8 and Signature 7–10, once your page list, facts, photos and account access are ready. Add your review time: two rounds, each allowing up to five business days. Your proposal confirms the start and launch dates; missing information or extra work can move them.

questions.question: Will the website appear in local search?
questions.answer: I plan around your actual services and customer questions and check the agreed search setup. Rankings and leads are not guaranteed. Google Business Profile work requires eligibility and approved access.
